description: This is a Java source file defining a Spring Boot REST controller named PercentController. It provides API endpoints for percentage calculations and modulo operations, including input validation and error handling.

classes.name: PercentController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller providing endpoints for percentage and modulo calculations with input validation.

methods.name: percent
methods.description: Calculates (a/100) * b from query parameters, with validation for missing or invalid inputs, returning the result or an error message.

methods.name: modulo
methods.description: Calculates a % b from query parameters, handling missing, invalid inputs and division by zero, returning the result or an error message.
